programme.title: Storage Wars Texas - Mary Defeats Auction
programme.desc: S2E15 - Moe and Mary uncover a rare piece of history during a stop in the city of Garland; Jenny becomes influenced by a popular book series; a buyer arrives loaded with cash. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars Texas - Take a Deep Breath, It's Lesa!
programme.desc: S3E2 - An old adversary pops up in the Houston suburb of Conroe; Moe and Mary feel the pressure; Ricky and Bubba try to profit from paranoia. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Flight of the Gambler
programme.desc: S5E1 - The locker-lookers return to Montebello, Calif., where Darrell hopes to repeat past successes; Brandi learns that Jarrod is facing an important problem. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - An Austrian in Perris
programme.desc: S13E18 - Brandi does everything she can to stay positive; Darrell finds a unit with some vintage totes, while Gunter plays on Rene's last nerve. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - All's Well That Urns Well
programme.desc: S4E7 - The buyers visit Orange, Calif.; Ivy Calvin finds collectibles in the garbage; Jarrod and Brandi hope to earn a profit. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Game of Groans: Whittier Is Coming
programme.desc: S13E7 - Kenny tries to reclaim the title of King of Whittier but has trouble amassing any shillings; Ivy & Ivy brave the cold to find their fortunes; Lisa finally graduates to full-fledged buyer, finding an unlikely mentor along the way. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Rules #1
programme.desc: S13E5 - Ivy brings his son to Moreno Valley, where good things always happen, and leaves with yo-yo's of an unexpected kind; Rene and Casey discover that their shoes are more "air" and less "Jordan." (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - She Bidded Me With Science!
programme.desc: S13E16 - Lisa decides to be fact-based in Placentia, Calif., inadvertently complicating international relations; Ivy and his son conjure up a locker with some mysterious sports equipment; Rene won't be taken advantage of, allowing him to record a nice win. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Top 10: Narrow Escapes
programme.desc: In this special countdown episode, everyday situations take sudden, dangerous turns when chaos erupts without warning. As tensions spike and stakes soar, split-second decisions mean the difference between disaster and survival. These are the close calls that prove sometimes making it out is the biggest win of all. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - High Stakes Heist
programme.desc: S8E3 - On an airplane in Los Angeles, two friends are confronted by the flight crew for wearing crop tops; in Atlanta, Georgia, police are called to a store to deal with two suspected shoplifters; at a golf course in West Kelowna, Canada, a dispute over slow play turns physical between two groups of golfers; in Bakersfield, California, a parking lot confrontation quickly becomes indecent; and off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, a shark-diving tourist panics as a great white crashes into his cage. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Shopping Bag Shenanigans
programme.desc: S4E7 - A customer at a big-box store in Encino, Calif., fumes as an item she purchased is no longer in her shopping bag; in Saugus, Mass., a man relaxing in a hot tub is shocked when he finds the gym has closed, and he is now locked inside. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Taxi Terror
programme.desc: S5E5 - At a bike shop in San Antonio, Texas, an employee faces off with a customer over some apparent confusion about the cost of a repair. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Tables and Tiaras
programme.desc: S6E1 - In Toronto, confusion over handicap accessibility on a streetcar causes tempers to flare; in Charlotte, N.C., an amateur fashion show devolves into an all out brawl; a plane is forced to make an emergency landing in Albuquerque, N.M. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Don't Mess With Grandma
programme.desc: S2E12 - In Fort Lauderdale, Fla., tempers flare during a flight's deboarding process as an impulsive passenger attempts to force his way down the aisle; in Cherry Hill, N.J., a mall-goer's unique outlook on life stuns the man interviewing him. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Can't Fight This Ceiling
programme.desc: S3E1 - In Las Vegas, a rideshare driver and passenger get into a heated altercation over an alleged door slam. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Barbershop Revenge
programme.desc: S5E10 - At a gym in Nebraska, a professional trainer's workout session is disrupted by unwanted advice from a male gym member; at a fast food restaurant in Kentucky, a disagreement between a customer and employees results in a chaotic altercation. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Takeout Trouble
programme.desc: S5E2 - A customer's demand for a refund spirals into a heated back and forth with employees; a rideshare trip takes a startling turn when a passenger doesn't exit the vehicle after being asked by the driver; an airline employee is moved to tears. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Porch Pirate Payback
programme.desc: S7E16 - In Duluth, Ga., an officer catches a customer allegedly using a borrowed police badge to get free snacks; in Lancaster, Pa., a driver jumps into her car mid-tow and tries to drive it off the lift; in Barranquilla, Colombia, passengers step in when a suspected thief's exit is blocked by a quick-thinking driver; in St. Louis, Mo., a woman wards off would-be thieves with a decoy package filled with an unpleasant surprise; in Nashville, Tenn., a customer goes on a destructive rampage at a store. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Exit Denied
programme.desc: S8E16 - At a Texas superstore, a customer gets irate after an employee asks to check her receipt before she leaves; in Florida, a man allegedly attacks a couple in a restaurant; a server who joins the brawl may know more than she admits; a simple trip to the store turns into a heated confrontation in a Michigan parking lot when one customer accuses another of illegally parking in a handicap space; in Thailand, a soccer player for a local team who refuses to pay his bar tab is confronted. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Supermarket Showdown
programme.desc: S8E15 - In California, a customer confronts her food delivery driver after an issue with her order. In Flagler Beach, Florida, a belligerent bar patron squanders multiple opportunities to avoid arrest. A shoplifting accusation at a supermarket in London, England, spirals into a violent clash. And on a flight in California, passengers face an emergency evacuation when the cabin begins filling with smoke. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Road Wars - Handcuff Houdini
programme.desc: S2E7 - In Canton, Ohio, a horn honk on the road allegedly leads to a man wreaking havoc on a woman's car; in Jonesboro, Ark., chaos ensues when a suspect manages to break free from his handcuffs and holds a lighter flame to the seat. (Documentary)

programme.title: Road Wars - All Keyed Up
programme.desc: S1E6 - A distracted police officer in Missouri strikes a bicyclist with his vehicle; a woman is caught red-handed keying another person's car in Louisiana; a motorcyclist crashes into a ditch after being sideswiped by a jeep in Illinois. (Documentary, Reality)

programme.title: Road Wars - Freeway Fiasco
programme.desc: S2E9 - In Kennebunk, Maine, a motorist gets into a dangerous confrontation with road workers; on a Texas highway off ramp, a stunned driver swerves to avoid a man who was ejected from his car moments earlier during an accident. (Documentary)

programme.title: Road Wars - This Boot Was Made For Drivin'
programme.desc: S8E8 - A driver clashes with parking enforcement as they boot his car in Chicago; a stunting biker on a Missouri highway gets a furious response from a pickup; a woman suffers a medical emergency on a Michigan freeway with her child in the car; a California woman loses her phone while filming out her sunroof; a plane attempts an emergency landing on a car-filled Florida interstate. (Documentary)

programme.title: Road Wars - Not on My Street
programme.desc: S1E7 - Professional photographers become the victims of a broad daylight smash and grab in San Francisco; in San Diego, an enraged dog walker goes ballistic when she confronts a speeding driver in her neighborhood. (Documentary)

programme.title: Road Wars - Snow Storm Pileup
programme.desc: S2E10 - In Hawaii, an altercation between two motorists escalates after one of them appears to be holding a pocket knife; on a highway in Rawlins, Wyo., a snow storm turns a single accident into a pileup involving nearly 100 vehicles. (Documentary)

programme.title: Road Wars - Taser vs. Hatchet
programme.desc: S7E5 - A tow truck driver in Connecticut confronts another motorist; police struggle to subdue a hatchet-wielding suspect in Ontario; an accident scene on an Oklahoma highway is crashed by another motorist; a car launches off a freeway overpass toward pedestrians below in India; a manure truck in Maine springs a leak; an apparent feud over a private car transaction turns dangerous in a Mississippi parking lot. (Documentary)

programme.title: Road Wars - Can't Outrun the Law
programme.desc: S6E2 - A motorcyclist fleeing from authorities in Wisconsin has a run in with the Sheriff; in Texas, an argument between two men at a red light erupts into a shirt-tearing brawl. A driver in Nevada loses his cool. (Documentary)

programme.desc: Marinette seems to be a normal teenage girl -- she dreams of becoming a fashion designer, is a bit awkward and has a crush on a classmate. But she has a secret other teenagers don't have -- she lives a double life as a crime-fighting superhero known as Ladybug. programme.desc: Marinette seems to be a normal teenage girl -- she dreams of becoming a fashion designer, is a bit awkward and has a crush on a classmate. But she has a secret other teenagers don't have -- she lives a double life as a crime-fighting superhero known as Ladybug. She uses her superpowers to help protect her native Paris from supervillain Hawk Moth. She is assisted, reluctantly, by fellow hero Cat Noir, even though she insists she doesn't need him -- a stance she might not take if she knew his alter ego is her crush, Adrien. Together, Ladybug and Cat Noir help keep Paris safe from Hawk Moth and other villains. (Animated, Children, Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: Friends - The One Where Rachel Goes Back to Work
programme.desc: S9E11 - When Rachel visits her workplace to show off baby Emma, she is surprised to find a handsome temporary worker, Gavin, who has been doing her job while she was on maternity leave; their immediate war of wills prompts Rachel to make a rash decision that she could regret; Joey arranges for Phoebe to get a job as an extra on his daytime drama series, but she wreaks havoc on the set. And, having quit his job, Chandler must get another, fast, because Monica desperately wants a family. - Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox Arquette, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry (Sitcom)

programme.title: Friends - The One With Phoebe's Rats

programme.title: Friends - The One Where Monica Sings
programme.desc: S9E13 - Monica exults in the applause she receives on karaoke night, unaware that the cheering audience can see through her blouse. - Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox Arquette, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry (Sitcom)

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Spock Resonance

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Mystery Date Observation
programme.desc: S9E8 - Sheldon, Wolowitz and Koothrappali post an ad online to find a new girlfriend for Sheldon; Penny and Bernadette decide to spy when Amy is secretive about who she is dating. - Johnny Galecki, Jim Parsons, Kaley Cuoco, Simon Helberg, Kunal Nayyar (Sitcom)

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Platonic Permutation

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Earworm Reverberation
programme.desc: S9E10 - Sheldon has a song stuck in his head; despite their awkward date, Amy asks Dave over for dinner; Koothrappali and Wolowitz are obsessed with a fan of their band. - Johnny Galecki, Jim Parsons, Kaley Cuoco, Simon Helberg, Kunal Nayyar (Sitcom)

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Opening Night Excitation

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Blind Dates

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Mugging

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Boob Job
programme.desc: S9E16 - Both Monica and Chandler secretly approach Joey for a loan; Phoebe invites Mike (Paul Rudd) to move in with her; Rachel baby-proofs the apartment. - Jennifer Aniston, Courteney Cox Arquette, Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry (Sitcom)

programme.title: Friends - The One With Rachel's Dream

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Soap Opera Party

programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Fist Fight

Virgil Cole (Willem Dafoe), are two soldiers embedded in the Vietnam War growing frustrated by the military's constraints on their missions. Despite the best efforts of their commanding officer, Cmdr. Frank Camparelli (Danny Glover), to re-engage them, this disillusioned pair decide to take the war effort into their own hands with an explosive battle plan that could well get them court-martialed. - Danny Glover, Willem Dafoe, Brad Johnson, Rosanna Arquette, Tom Sizemore (War, Historical drama)

The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. - Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon, Josh Brolin, Barry Pepper, Hailee Steinfeld (Western, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: No Country for Old Men

The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. - Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin, Woody Harrelson, Kelly Macdonald (Crime drama, Thriller, Western)

When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree. - Denzel Washington, Kelly Lynch, Russell Crowe, Stephen Spinella, William Forsythe (Action)

Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden, Harry Styles, Aneurin Barnard (War, Historical drama, Action)

Gen. Joseph Campbell (James Cromwell). - John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe, James Cromwell, Timothy Hutton, Leslie Stefanson (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery)

Austin, Lisa Kudrow, Kevin Dillon, Don Cheadle (Children, Comedy, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents. - Rod Steiger, Jeff Saumier, Ray Aranha, Mark Camacho, Jane Wheeler (Drama)

Picard (Patrick Stewart), learns that one of the disaster's survivors, Dr. Soran (Malcolm McDowell), plans to enter the field by destroying a neighboring star. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame. - Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy, Jennifer Hudson, Anika Noni Rose (Musical, Drama)

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. - Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border. - Brad Pitt, Julia Roberts, James Gandolfini, Bob Balaban, J.K. Simmons (Comedy drama, Adventure, Romance)

programme.title: Twister
programme.desc: During the approach of the most powerful storm in decades, university professor Dr. Jo Harding (Helen Hunt) and an underfunded team of students prepares the prototype for Dorothy, a ground-breaking tornado data-gathering device conceived by her estranged husband, Bill (Bill Paxton). When Harding tells Bill that Dorothy is ready for testing -- and that their privately funded rival Dr. Jonas Miller (Cary Elwes) has stolen the idea and built his own -- Bill rejoins the team for one last mission. - Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton, Cary Elwes, Jami Gertz, Lois Smith (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Willem Dafoe, Kristin Scott Thomas, Naveen Andrews (Romance, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
programme.desc: Zack Mayo (Richard Gere), a new member of the U.S. Navy, has a bad attitude. When he signs up for the Aviation Academy, he is met with the strict leadership of Sgt. Emil Foley (Louis Gossett Jr.), who gives Zack a rude awakening in terms of relating with other people. Through Foley's guidance -- and an unexpected romance with Paula (Debra Winger), an outsider who hangs around the naval base -- Zack learns some tough lessons and discovers what he truly wants out of life. - Richard Gere, Debra Winger, Louis Gossett Jr., David Keith, Robert Loggia (Drama)

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons. - Patrick Swayze, Demi Moore, Whoopi Goldberg, Tony Goldwyn, Rick Aviles (Fantasy, Romance, Drama, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Safe Haven
programme.desc: Katie Feldman moves to a small town on the North Carolina coast, determined to make a new life for herself. She takes a job as a waitress and keeps a low profile, but she is soon won over by the warmth and caring of the close-knit community, especially that of Alex, a widower. With the help of Alex and his children, Katie learns to love and trust again, but when a mysterious stranger arrives and starts asking questions, Katie's dark past threatens to reclaim her. - Josh Duhamel, Julianne Hough, Cobie Smulders, David Lyons, Noah Lomax (Romance, Drama, Thriller, Mystery, Fantasy)

programme.title: Blue Valentine
programme.desc: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage. - Ryan Gosling, Michelle Williams, Faith Wladyka, John Doman, Mike Vogel (Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Urban Cowboy
programme.desc: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition. - John Travolta, Debra Winger, Scott Glenn, Madolyn Smith, Barry Corbin (Drama)

programme.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
programme.desc: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician. - Miya Cech, Rhea Perlman, Leonardo Nam, Kannon, Paulina Lule (Comedy)

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues. - Elizabeth Banks, Emily Browning, Arielle Kebbel, David Strathairn, Jesse Moss (Horror, Thriller, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery)

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. - Goldie Hawn, Bette Midler, Diane Keaton, Maggie Smith, Sarah Jessica Parker (Comedy)

programme.title: Falling in Love
programme.desc: Commuting to Manhattan on the same train, two married strangers (Robert De Niro, Meryl Streep) meet by accident and have an affair. - Robert De Niro, Meryl Streep, Harvey Keitel, Jane Kaczmarek, George Martin (Romance)

programme.title: The Butcher's Wife
programme.desc: Clairvoyant Marina (Demi Moore) meets New York City butcher Leo Lemke (George Dzundza) while he is visiting her small town in North Carolina. When she then dreams about him, she believes it is a sign that he is her true love. She marries Leo and moves to his working-class neighborhood in New York City. There she meets his neighbors, including shy singer Stella (Mary Steenburgen) and psychiatrist Alex Tremor (Jeff Daniels). Soon Marina begins to wonder if she was wrong about her soul mate. - Demi Moore, Jeff Daniels, George Dzundza, Mary Steenburgen, Frances McDormand (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. - Matt Damon, Gwyneth Paltrow, Jude Law, Cate Blanchett, Philip Seymour Hoffman (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance)

programme.title: Haunter
programme.desc: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. - Abigail Breslin, Stephen McHattie, Peter Outerbridge, Michelle Nolden, David Hewlett (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Proof
programme.desc: Catherine (Gwyneth Paltrow) is a 27-year-old grieving after the loss of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a genius mathematician whose mind gradually deteriorated from mental illness. With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn. - Gwyneth Paltrow, Anthony Hopkins, Jake Gyllenhaal, Hope Davis, Gary Houston (Drama)

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him. - Jay Baruchel, Alice Eve, T.J. Miller, Mike Vogel, Nate Torrence (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first? - Natalie Portman, Ashton Kutcher, Cary Elwes, Kevin Kline, Lake Bell (Romantic comedy)

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: A New Jersey bartender (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) embarks on his first genuine relationship with a woman (Scarlett Johansson), but his constant craving for Internet porn threatens to bring things crashing down.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: A strong-willed woman (Shirley MacLaine) and her equally independent daughter (Debra Winger) keep the lines of communication open as each deals with the curveballs life throws at them.

programme.title: Racing With the Moon
programme.desc: Two buddies (Sean Penn, Nicolas Cage) with girlfriends hop trains for kicks before joining the Marines in 1942 California.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Befuddled mom-to-be Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) must figure out which of the two men (Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey) in her life is the father of her child.

programme.title: Jersey Girl
programme.desc: A young woman (Liv Tyler) changes the life of a single father (Ben Affleck) who used to be a successful New York music publicist.

programme.title: The Drug Lords Next Door
programme.desc: Undercover reporting reveals the rise of Albanian gangs taking over Britain's cocaine trade, from international supply lines to local streets.
